checks.native_scope: C ASan/UBSan with uninstrumented release Rust; leak sanitizer disabled.

attribute_oracle_disposition: All 5796 results are identical to the shared-state baseline, including positions. All 252 reference error differences are existing NDATA error16 versus15, and all 732 event differences are existing replacement CRLF folding.

alias_oracle.disposition: Existing CDATA replacement CRLF folding; the other 102 cases match Expat.

independent_review.scope: Read-only iterative lexical composition against daeb7f9 in API worktree
independent_review.analysis: Each parent Frame retains a lexical Slice derived from the current Slice, preserving converted alias provenance across child returns. Decoded temporary names only serve lookup; active/frame names borrow stable map keys. Parser borrow is immutable and no callbacks or map mutations occur during expansion. Active insertion/frame push are fallible, errors drop local state, and accounting/recursive/depth checks retain prior ordering. Recycled output reserves before clearing and partial error output never escapes. append_lexical_attribute preserves raw_ascii distinctions and existing per-literal normalization; the semantic normalization correction remains separate.

limits: No limit changes. The 60,000-level growing-prefix test opts into increased entity count/depth on a 256 KiB thread stack. The wide diamond still stops at its configured 4,096-byte expansion cap. Selected-allocator fail-point coverage includes explicit stack/active-set growth.
separate_work: Attribute replacement whitespace and NDATA diagnostics remain a separate semantic layer. No production speed claim is made from these correctness tests.
